note: The Credit Reporting Act, 2010, section 12(2)(h), as the Bank of Jamaica publishes it: a bureau may not provide adverse information it hasn't verified within the seven years before, written as seven years. The Act is a scanned PDF with no text, read by eye. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Bank of Jamaica, The Credit Reporting Act, 2010 (Act 27 of 2010)
sources.said: Section 12(2): Credit information provided to any person by a credit bureau under the provisions of this Act shall not include— ... (h) any information adverse to the consumer that has not been verified by the credit bureau at any time during a period of seven years immediately preceding the date on which the information is provided; [The Act is a scanned image with no text layer; read by eye on page 22 of the PDF.]
